title: Remote, Node, And Browser Productization
goal: Additive remote, browser, and operator diagnostics inside Friday's single-hub trust domain without opening deferred federation or mesh scope.

implementationWorkers.title: Add browser profile diagnostics and operator-facing fleet routing summaries

repairWorker.title: Diagnose remote/browser blockers without leaving the single-hub trust model

successCriteria: Remote and browser diagnostics remain additive within existing fleet and observability authority.
Browser profile work stays bounded to operator, automation, and remote diagnostics instead of introducing a second browser runtime story.
No federation, mesh, mDNS, or Tailscale-native discovery work is introduced.

forbiddenBoundaries.description: Phase 4 must not expand Friday beyond the current single-hub trust domain.

notes: Phase 4 stays additive: no new route family, no topology expansion, and no connector or plugin authority drift.
Operator routing summaries should point toward existing /fleet, /observability, and /assistant surfaces instead of creating a new control plane.
